description_id: Bundle skill + template Deep Researcher v2. Riset topik kompleks dari banyak sumber, evaluasi kredibilitas per sumber, citation rapi per claim, dan sintesis jadi laporan terstruktur. Literature review, market analysis, competitor scan, kebijakan / regulasi research.

skills.description_id: Riset topik dari sumber web — pecah topik jadi sub-pertanyaan, web search + scraping per sub-pertanyaan, kumpulkan source set dengan metadata. Prioritas paper akademik, laporan resmi, reporting jurnalistik.
skills.description_en: Research a topic from web sources — decompose into sub-questions, web search + scrape per sub-question, gather a source set with metadata. Prioritizes academic papers, official reports, journalistic reporting.

skills.description_id: Nilai kredibilitas tiap sumber pakai rubrik lima dimensi (authority, recency, primary/secondary, bias, corroboration). Output tier A-D per sumber sebagai pegangan untuk sintesis.
skills.description_en: Grade each source's credibility on a five-dimension rubric (authority, recency, primary/secondary, bias, corroboration). Outputs an A-D tier per source to anchor synthesis.

skills.description_id: Format citation + susun daftar pustaka dari source set — footnote-numbered (default), APA, atau author-date. Tandai metadata yang tidak lengkap, tidak menebak field yang tidak diketahui.
skills.description_en: Format citations + build a reference list from a source set — footnote-numbered (default), APA, or author-date. Flags incomplete metadata, never guesses unknown fields.

skills.description_id: Susun laporan riset terstruktur dari source set yang sudah dinilai dan di-citation — TL;DR, key findings dengan evidence, detail, konflik antar sumber, gaps. Brief-memo, executive-summary, atau full-report.
skills.description_en: Compose a structured research report from a graded, cited source set — TL;DR, key findings with evidence, detail, source conflicts, gaps. Brief-memo, executive-summary, or full-report.

skills.description_id: Generate skill / template baru saat customer minta sesuatu yang belum ada di inventory. Pakai LLM customer (BYOK), simpan ke /var/lib/weuseai/customer-grown/.
skills.description_en: Generate a new skill or template at runtime when the customer asks for something not in inventory.

templates.description_id: Rubrik penilaian kredibilitas sumber — lima dimensi (authority, recency, primary/secondary, bias, corroboration) plus tier akhir A-D.
Kerangka tetap laporan riset — TL;DR, key findings, detail, konflik antar sumber, gaps, sumber. Tiga format: brief-memo, executive-summary, full-report.
